description: Where a picture you made can be posted and when: each of the project's connected accounts that takes a picture, with a time for it (the day the owner named, else the next good time) in the project's own time zone, and whether it is posted or going there already. With nothing connected, it says where to connect. Spends nothing.

day.description: the day the owner named for it (YYYY-MM-DD, in the project's own time zone); omitted, the next good time

item_id.description: the picture in the set; omitted, its first made picture

project.description: The project's id or exact name. Optional when the account has one project.

set_id.description: the picture's set, as canvas_run's answer gives it; left out, the picture this chat last made

name: post_options
title: Post options
